author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: IT Glue has no syslog or log export push: workflow webhooks only send a payload you write, from a variable list shown in the app, and take no custom header. The activity log is available from GET /logs, so collectors/it-glue-activity-logs pulls it and posts each record unchanged to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration. Every record goes to CloudAudit with the event name resource-type.action (for example Password.update), the user ID, address and user agent; level 1 records, which change no data, are marked read only. The record names the user by ID only. Fields follow the /logs example in the IT Glue API docs, which only shows a create; the docs don't list the action names, so the samples' show action on a level 1 Password record is made up, and so are all values. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (51 of 51 fields matched the emulator). No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
